tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thanks for your time! What specific skills do you hope to gain from this internship that your major courses can't provide?
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢你的参与！你希望从这次实习中获得哪些专业课程无法提供的具体技能？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: I see. Some argue employers value internship experience more than GPA, while others believe academic excellence matters most. Which view do you agree with, and why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：我明白了。有人认为雇主更看重实习经历而非平均学分绩点（GPA），也有人认为学业优异最为重要。你更认同哪种观点？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. Imagine a conflict like this: Would you prefer to attend the important team meetings at your internship company or the important lectures in your classroom? Explain your choice.
tasks.analysis: 中文：很有意思。假设出现一个冲突：你会优先参加实习单位的重要团队会议，还是学校的专业核心讲座？请说明你的选择理由。
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Good points. Finally, should all internships pay students, even in non-profit fields like education or government?
tasks.analysis: 中文：观点很有道理。最后一个问题：所有实习都应该给学生支付报酬吗？即便是教育、政府等非营利领域的实习？
tasks.title: Interview
